description: Ex Royal Thai Army. Long reported as 68-16377, but the modification plate shows 10160, which ties to Thai Army UH-1 68-15230. On display since April 1996.
Ex Royal Thai Army; radio call 5877, but that serial belongs to an airworthy machine with Tango, so the identity is unresolved. Cockpit bubble glazing removed during 2021.
Ex US 56-2633, confirmed from the panel coaming plate; data plate missing. 3121 was visible under the paint before repainting in 2018.
Small parts of the wrecked tail only. Ex USAF 66-9161, written off 6 October 1970.
Wreckage displayed since December 2015; the museum board records a crash in 1973 in Phetchabun province. This may be 6423, which crashed in July 1972 about 9km south-south-west of Khao Kho.
